versions.changelog:
Pants-designer skill initial release:

- Generates customized pants/trousers designs for print-on-demand (POD) and manufacturing-on-demand (MOD).
- Supports structured clothing parameters, reference images, custom text/logos, interactive 3D viewers, and multi-view design generation.
- Provides an API for generating design drafts from prompts, images, or structured inputs.
- Includes integration with the Craftsman Agent Manufacturing Platform to connect with suppliers.
- Offers a detailed workflow and quick start guide for creating and managing pants/trousers designs.
